doc.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Leaving Ole Miss with Taylor LaFarge; Audre's letters
summary: They left Oxford for Texas and picked up the Nat Garner Trio in Lafayette; Audre was drawn to his moody letters.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Not long after that, you decided to hit the road and to try playing music professionally. Now, to your recollection (and Audre can comment with accuracy, too, because you were now on the scene), was there a real connection between...

Well, I went to... Taylor LaFarge had a... We left the University of Mississippi, and we were on the way to Texas, and we came across Lafayette, Louisiana, and that’s where we got the Nat Garner Trio.

Well, I wrote to Mose during that period. I was still in St. Louis. I just remember re-reading your letters, that he always seemed kind of morose about things, about the way of the world, and I was so young, I thought that was so much more interesting than the boys I was dating, who were all thrilled about basketball trophies and things.
